race.comment: Leaning to BAYWATCH (8) who got home strongly behind a handy one in Blue Willow at Sandown Hillside last start to grab second. Still an improving mare who stays down in the weights and should be hard to hold out/ TEMPRANILLO (6) was third in the Blue Willow race albeit beaten eight lengths on very testing ground. The run prior up in grade behind Silent Shares is solid form for this and Damian Lane on is a plus. LICENTIOUS (9) has been okay since a fresh win, tackling a 3yo open race at Flemington two back when close up before another bunched finish last time. She should take holding out. MEH KEFFI (3) is back in class and worth respecting, as is SAPPHIRE SIREN (4) who resumes with a nice profile.
